claims.statement: The domain note warns that article commands/examples use product_url while the user's GitHub deployment may use another domain, illustrated by octocorp.ghe.com. The inspected product_url variable resolves to github.com for fpt/ghec and HOSTNAME otherwise. These are source example/placeholder branches, not the actual enterprise host, validated endpoint, or authorization to retarget commands.

The SSH note describes substituting git at product_url with the illustrated octocorp user at octocorp.ghe.com when using a different domain. This changes both the example SSH user and host, not just DNS, but is not a finding about the user's actual enterprise SSH identity, key trust, credentials, or remote parity. No SSH connection or remote configuration was changed.
